e: Two-year fixed-term research associate in RAL's Particle Physics Department working on neutron-veto background mitigation and dark matter search analysis for the DarkSide-20k liquid argon experiment, with optional work on QUEST-DMC. Requires a PhD (or near completion) in particle physics or similar; no citizenship limits stated, and the ad says applicants who need UK visa sponsorship pay the Home Office costs themselves.
n: STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory: Research Associate on DarkSide-20k
